sara_marketing: FYI: spikes this morning caused HubSpot enrichment to stall and led to claim delays past our 2min SLA.
sara_marketing: ~8% of leads affected during a 10m window.
alex_salesops: Quick fix idea: don't block RR claim on enrichment. Two options: optimistic temporary owner OR immediate fallback assignment after short debounce.
jason_revops: Metrics we need: p99 claim latency, fallback count, enrichment slow count. Alert if p99 > 2m or fallback_rate > 1% for score>=60.
tia_eng: Can add a "pending-fast" enrichment response when upstream latency >2s so workflows don't block. Feature flag for a canary.
maria_growth: For reps, we'll use a temp owner field and communicate that it is transient to avoid confusion. Update runbook.
alex_salesops: Proposed rollout: 10% canary with optimistic claim + 0-20s jitter, fallback to `inbound-ops` after 4m.
sara_marketing: Ops checklist: tia -> flag, alex -> workflow + jitter, jason -> dashboards, maria -> comms. Revert plan if alerts fire.
